annotations.title: Ad platforms a conversion goes to

description: The ad platform conversions APIs send_conversion_event sends to, per brand. action list (default) shows them plus what each platform needs; add saves one: platform (meta, tiktok, linkedin, snapchat, reddit, pinterest, x, microsoft, chatgpt, applovin, amazon) with its ids (Meta pixelId + adAccountId; TikTok eventSourceId = the pixel CODE, eventSource web/offline/crm, advertiserId; LinkedIn conversionId of a Conversions API rule; Snapchat pixelId; Reddit pixelId; Pinterest adAccountId; X pixelId and eventId; Microsoft conversionName of an OFFLINE goal; ChatGPT Ads pixelSnippetId + apiKey, the Conversions API key, stored encrypted and never shown again; Amazon amazonProfileId + countryCode). eventNames limits which events it takes (LinkedIn and Microsoft need it: their rule or goal decides the type); eventMap renames one of yours to the platform’s, e.g. {"QualifiedLead":"CUSTOM_EVENT_1"}. Meta pixels, Amazon profiles and LinkedIn rules are checked against the brand’s own account when added; the rest on the first send. action remove takes destinationId. Free.

adAccountId.description: the ad account, where the platform has several shared

eventMap.description: your event name to this platform’s event name

eventNames.description: the events this destination takes; omit for every event

eventSourceId.description: TikTok pixel code, offline or CRM event set id

pixelId.description: Meta / Snapchat / Reddit / X pixel id

platform.description: add: meta, tiktok, linkedin, snapchat, reddit, pinterest, x, microsoft, chatgpt, applovin or amazon
